company.name: Kitsch
company.description: Kitsch is a beauty and lifestyle brand known for satin pillowcases, hair accessories, heatless curling sets, shampoo bars, and self-care products. Sold DTC and through major retail partners including Target, Ulta, Walmart, Nordstrom, and CVS.

retail_accounts.notes: Top retail partner. Holiday planogram confirmed. Opportunity to expand shampoo bar assortment in Q1 2027.
Strongest velocity on Heatless Curling Set and Shampoo Bars. Buyer interested in exclusive colorway for Q2 2027. End cap placement confirmed for holiday.
Underperforming vs plan. Fill rate issues flagged. In-stock rate on pillowcases below 85%. Claw clips over-indexed — buyer open to expanding accessories assortment.
Gift sets performing above expectations. Buyer reviewing Satin Eye Mask for expanded floor placement. Holiday gift set sell-through at 72%.
Limited assortment (satin pillowcase + claw clips + scrunchies). Shampoo bar test in 200 doors Q4. In-stock issues impacting performance. Opportunity to add Heatless Curling Set.
Highest volume channel. Heatless Curling Set #3 BSR in Hair Accessories. Shampoo Bars #1 BSR in Solid Shampoo. Subscribe & Save penetration at 28% for haircare SKUs.
Highest margin channel. Email and paid social driving strongest CAC efficiency. Subscription revenue up 34% YoY on haircare bundles. Holiday landing page live Oct 1.

inventory_risk_report.summary: 3 SKUs are at critical or at-risk inventory levels ahead of the holiday season. The Heatless Curling Set and Satin Eye Mask are below 2 weeks of supply with no confirmed inbound shipments covering demand. The Satin Pillowcase - Queen is approaching reorder point with 10 weeks lead time — order must be placed by Oct 1 to avoid stockout before Black Friday.

critical_skus.name: Heatless Curling Set
critical_skus.risk: Projected stockout Oct 12. 20,000 units on order but arrival estimated Nov 4 — 3-week gap. Top-selling SKU at Target and Ulta. Recommend expedited freight to cover gap.
critical_skus.action_required: Expedite inbound shipment or air freight 5,000 units to cover Oct 12 - Nov 4 window.

critical_skus.name: Satin Eye Mask
critical_skus.risk: No PO placed. At current velocity, stockout by Oct 5. Lead time 10 weeks means earliest replenishment is Dec. Holiday sales window will be missed entirely.
critical_skus.action_required: Place emergency PO immediately. Consider air freight for initial run of 3,000 units.

at_risk_skus.name: Satin Pillowcase - Queen
at_risk_skus.risk: Below reorder point with 10-week lead time. Holiday demand surge expected +40% in Nov-Dec. Must order by Oct 1 to land inventory before Black Friday.
at_risk_skus.action_required: Issue PO for 15,000 units by Oct 1.

at_risk_skus.name: Repair Shampoo Bar
at_risk_skus.risk: Below reorder point with 8-week lead time. Ulta planogram expansion in Q4 will increase allocation needs.
at_risk_skus.action_required: Issue PO for 10,000 units within 2 weeks.

at_risk_skus.name: Curl & Style Gift Set
at_risk_skus.risk: Holiday gift set. 6,000 units on order but holiday allocation to Nordstrom and DTC already totals 5,200 units. Net available post-allocation = only 2,200 units.
at_risk_skus.action_required: Confirm holiday allocations and consider increasing PO to 10,000 units.

retail_performance_report.summary: Kitsch retail is tracking +6% above plan YTD across strategic accounts. Amazon and DTC remain the top-volume channels. Ulta is the strongest specialty retailer, outperforming plan by 12%. Walmart is the primary underperformer at -13% vs plan, driven by in-stock issues on pillowcases. CVS fill rate has dropped below 87% — jeopardizing the Q4 shampoo bar door expansion.

top_performers.highlight: Heatless Curling Set #3 BSR in Hair Accessories. Shampoo Bars #1 BSR in Solid Shampoo. Subscribe & Save penetration at 28%.
Highest in-stock rate across all retail (95%). End cap confirmed for holiday. Buyer open to exclusive colorway.
Subscription revenue +34% YoY. Email CAC down 18% vs prior year. Holiday landing page live.

underperformers.recommended_action: Address logistics and replenishment cadence. Review pillowcase allocation model for high-volume Walmart doors.

issues: Q4 shampoo bar expansion at risk if fill rate not improved
underperformers.recommended_action: Prioritize CVS fill rate before Q4 shampoo bar test. Engage ops team to review DC routing.

campaign_performance.description: TikTok and Instagram paid social campaign targeting college-aged women for back-to-school season. Featured UGC-style creative of the heatless curling set morning routine.
campaign_performance.target_audience: Women 18-28, interest in beauty, hair care, college lifestyle
campaign_performance.top_creative: UGC morning routine reel — 3.2M views, 6.4% engagement rate
campaign_performance.notes: TikTok outperformed Instagram 3:1 on CVR. Viral moment on Aug 14 drove 40% of month's conversions in 3 days. Recommend always-on TikTok budget.

campaign_performance.description: Multi-channel holiday campaign positioning satin pillowcases and sleep gift sets as the perfect self-care gift. Ran across email, paid search, and Pinterest.
campaign_performance.target_audience: Women 25-45, gift shoppers, existing customers + lookalike audiences
campaign_performance.top_creative: Email: 'The Gift She Actually Wants' — 48.2% open rate, 11.4% CTR
campaign_performance.notes: Email drove 62% of revenue at lowest CPA ($3.10). Pinterest drove strong gift set discovery. Paid search captured high-intent 'satin pillowcase gift' queries. ROAS well above 4x target.

campaign_performance.description: Awareness and conversion campaign for the Restore Shampoo Bar targeting eco-conscious beauty shoppers. Influencer seeding + paid social + organic content.
campaign_performance.target_audience: Women 22-40, interest in sustainable beauty, clean haircare, zero-waste lifestyle
campaign_performance.top_creative: YouTube pre-roll '30-day shampoo bar switch challenge' — 2.1M views, 4.8% click-through
campaign_performance.notes: ROAS below 2x target due to low AOV on single-SKU shampoo bar. Recommend bundling with conditioner bar or promoting multi-pack to lift AOV. Strong new customer acquisition (83%) — high LTV potential from Eco Shopper segment.

campaign_performance.description: Product launch campaign for seasonal claw clip colorways. Heavy TikTok organic amplification + paid retargeting to existing customers and site visitors.
campaign_performance.target_audience: Women 16-34, existing Kitsch customers + 90-day site visitors + lookalike
campaign_performance.top_creative: TikTok 'color drop' reveal video — 5.6M organic views, 420K saves
campaign_performance.notes: Lowest CPA of all campaigns ($4.94) driven by strong organic TikTok halo effect. Retargeting to existing customers converted at 8.2% CVR. AOV limited by single-item clip price — future campaigns should push clip bundles or outfit pairings to lift basket.

campaign_insights.summary: Across 4 campaigns, Kitsch generated $611K in attributed revenue on $165K spend (3.71x blended ROAS). The Holiday Gift Guide (cp002) was the highest-revenue campaign at $416K and 6.68x ROAS. The Shampoo Bar launch (cp003) underperformed on ROAS (1.01x) due to low single-item AOV — bundling is the key lever. TikTok is Kitsch's strongest paid channel, driving viral moments on both the Heatless Curling Set and Claw Clip campaigns.
campaign_insights.top_campaign_by_roas: cp002 — Satin Sleep Holiday Gift Guide (6.68x)
campaign_insights.top_campaign_by_conversions: cp002 — Satin Sleep Holiday Gift Guide (8,680 conversions)
campaign_insights.top_campaign_by_new_customers: cp003 — Shampoo Bar Eco Beauty Launch (83% new customers)
campaign_insights.lowest_cpa_campaign: cp004 — Claw Clip Spring Drop ($4.94 CPA)
key_insights: TikTok organic amplification is Kitsch's most powerful growth lever — cp001 and cp004 both benefited from viral moments that multiplied paid reach at no extra cost
Email is the highest-ROAS channel within multi-channel campaigns — Holiday Gift Guide email alone drove 62% of cp002 revenue
Shampoo Bar AOV ($14) is too low for efficient standalone paid campaigns — bundle with Conditioner Bar or promote multi-packs to hit $28+ AOV
Gift sets command higher AOV ($48) and strong gifting-intent conversion — lean into this positioning for Q4 and Valentine's Day
83% new customer rate on Shampoo Bar campaign suggests eco-beauty audience is a strong acquisition pool with high LTV potential (Eco Shoppers segment: $154 CLV)
recommendations: Launch always-on TikTok campaign for Heatless Curling Set — proven viral product with repeatable content format
Bundle Restore + Repair Shampoo Bar in next eco campaign to lift AOV above $25
Expand Holiday Gift Guide to include Curl & Style Gift Set alongside Satin Sleep Set
Test Pinterest as a standalone channel for gift campaigns — strong gift discovery performance in cp002
Retarget Shampoo Bar purchasers (cp003) with Conditioner Bar email sequence — high LTV segment, low acquisition cost already paid

anomalies.description: Heatless Curling Set weeks-of-supply collapsed to 1.6 weeks — well below the 6-week safety stock target. Projected stockout Oct 12 ahead of holiday season.
CVS in-stock rate on Satin Pillowcase - Queen dropped to 79%. Below the 90% threshold required for healthy sell-through and continuation of the Q4 shampoo bar door expansion.
Walmart pillowcase return rate spiked to 6% — 2x the expected range. Possible consumer expectation mismatch with packaging or sizing. Needs root cause analysis before buyer meeting.
August MoM revenue growth hit 5.8% — above the 2-4.5% expected range. Driven by back-to-school social campaign and TikTok viral moment on Heatless Curling Set.
Satin Eye Mask weeks-of-supply at 1.5 with no open PO. Stockout projected Oct 5. Holiday sales window will be entirely missed if not addressed immediately.

insight_reports.summary: Three SKUs face critical inventory risk ahead of the holiday season: Heatless Curling Set (1.6 weeks supply, stockout Oct 12), Satin Eye Mask (1.5 weeks, no PO placed, stockout Oct 5), and Satin Pillowcase - Queen (at reorder point, must order by Oct 1). Immediate action required on two critical SKUs to protect Q4 revenue.

Satin Eye Mask had no reorder triggered despite being below safety stock since Aug 15

Review holiday allocation model to flag at-risk SKUs earlier in the season

query_history.sql: SELECT sku, name, weeks_of_supply, status FROM inventory WHERE status IN ('critical','at_risk') ORDER BY weeks_of_supply ASC
SELECT account_name, ytd_gmv_usd, ytd_gmv_vs_plan_pct, in_stock_rate_pct, fill_rate_pct FROM retail_accounts ORDER BY ytd_gmv_usd DESC
SELECT account_name, sku, units_sold, sell_through_rate, in_stock_rate FROM pos_data WHERE period='2026-09' ORDER BY units_sold DESC
SELECT account_name, buyer_name, meeting_date, ytd_gmv_vs_plan_pct FROM retail_accounts WHERE next_review_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY next_review_date ASC
SELECT campaign_name, spend_usd, revenue_attributed_usd, roas, cpa_usd, conversions FROM marketing_campaigns.campaign_performance ORDER BY roas DESC
SELECT campaign_name, channel, new_customer_pct, avg_order_value, top_creative FROM marketing_campaigns.campaign_performance ORDER BY new_customer_pct DESC
